Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Magnesium
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of magnesium by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for magnesium. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-153
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_1 when using tools use this path.

{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_1/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS input script for calculating elastic constants of Magnesium
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data magnesium_data.lammps

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable deformat equal 1e-06

# Loop over deformation modes
label loop
variable i loop 6

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x scale ${deformat} remap units box"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y scale ${deformat} remap units box"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z scale ${deformat} remap units box"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta ${deformat} remap units box"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta ${deformat} remap units box"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta ${deformat} remap units box"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Write stress tensor
variable stress equal "-pxx -pyy -pzz -pyz -pxz -pxy"
thermo_style custom step v_stress
thermo 1
run 0

# Next deformation mode
next i
goto loop

# End of script
"}
